posts.description: Update: Automatic server-side drop shadows were reverted because that regressed the visuals of a reasonable number of apps. posts.title: Addressing global removal race in Wayland
posts.description: Global objects are one of the core abstractions in Wayland. They are used to announce supported protocols or announce semi-transient objects, for example available outputs. The compositor can add and remove global objects on the fly.
